messages:
maria (infosec): Heads-up: Compliance wants tighter egress defaults in eu-west-1 next Tue 02:00 UTC. This will deny outbound to a few legacy endpoints used by the GPU onboarding path. Could block new nodes from fetching ephemeral KMS grants.

sam (platform): Which endpoints exactly? can we get an allowlist? :thinking_face:

maria (infosec): The rule targets non-approved outbound IP ranges. Affected services: keystore.internal.redwood, bootstrap-shard-3.redwood, and a telemetry sink we still have whitelisted. Firewall rule id: fw-eu-2026-07.

raj (infra): Saw the same in staging yesterday — new nodes hit: `keystore: handshake timeout after 10s` then `node-init: failed to obtain ephemeral-key`. Logs: ```
2026-03-11T08:22:10Z node-23 init ERROR: keystore handshake failed: tcp timeout
2026-03-11T08:22:12Z node-23 init WARN: falling back to local cached grant -> degraded warmup
```

kevin (oncall): We also observed GPU pool drain in staging: warm-pool occupancy fell from 85% -> 40% in ~6m when the egress rule applied. Noticed increased token re-use due to cache fallback.

jen (sre): Short-term mitigation: can we add a temporary audit-sampling exception for the bootstrap path only? That keeps compliance logs but allows traffic. Longer-term we should route keystore calls through the proxy in the approved CIDR.

maria (infosec): Compliance will consider a scoped exception if we provide: 1) exact IPs/domains, 2) timebox (max 48h), 3) audit retention bumped to 180d for those flows. Can the platform team provide the list + justification by EOD?

sam (platform): I can generate the list. Proposal: allow `keystore.internal.redwood:443`, `bootstrap-shard-*.redwood:443`, and `10.200.4.0/24` (edge proxy). I will open a PR to the fw config: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/1245 with the patch and an ACL diff.

raj (infra): Parallel action: add a canary rollout for node onboarding so only 1 AZ at a time uses the exception. Script snippet to toggle: ```bash
# toggle canary on/off
./ops/node-onboard --region eu-west-1 --az a --canary on
```

kevin (oncall): If ops agrees, I'll watch the warm-pool metrics and rollback if GPU offer rate drops >20% or keystore 5xxs spike.

maria (infosec): Also need a short incident note for auditors. audit-bot, please create a ticket with the firewall change, list of approving managers, and retention change.

audit-bot: Created ticket AUD-2026-331 with summary "Scoped egress exception for GPU onboarding (eu-west-1)" — assignees: maria (infosec), sam (platform). Link: https://tickets.redwood/AUD-2026-331

jen (sre): Quick checklist for PR: include a smoke test that confirms `curl -sSf https://keystore.internal.redwood/health` from a new node, and a runbook snippet to revoke the exception: ```bash
# revoke exception
./infra/fwctl apply --rule-id fw-eu-2026-07 --remove-exception onboarders
```

sam (platform): PR posted, added smoke test and canary steps. tagging @maria for approval.

maria (infosec): Approved for a 24h exception window. I want audit retention increased and a post-mortem that explains why we still rely on legacy endpoints. :white_check_mark: 

raj (infra): Will schedule node backfills starting in 30m once PR merges. Monitoring hooks: `gpu_warmpool_fill`, `keystore_handshake_5xx` on PagerDuty.

kevin (oncall): I'll hold the oncall channel and keep updates short. ping me if warm-pool falls or keystore error rate > 1% for 5m.

maria (infosec): Thanks all — let's aim to remove the exception within 24h and have the proxy path ready next sprint.

sam (platform): noted. merging PR now. :rocket:
